test_rebuild_models_with_both_models: test that Config rebuilds models list with both primary and secondary models set via CLI overrides
test_rebuild_models_primary_only: test that Config rebuilds models list with only a primary model and default weight of 1.0
test_rebuild_models_with_weights: test that Config rebuilds models with custom primary and secondary model weights
test_rebuild_models_zero_weight_secondar: test that Config excludes secondary model from models list when its weight is set to zero
test_rebuild_preserves_shared_config: test that Config rebuild_models preserves shared LLM settings like api_base and temperature on new model objects
